compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
22 modules under `tests/unit/metrics/` (13 pairs), `tests/unit/workflow/` (3 pairs) and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` (6 pairs: 2 in `diffing/`, 3 in `state/`, 1 at the package root) have a `<name>_heldout.py` twin. Once both oracles have been reviewed the split only doubles module count, duplicates identical helper definitions, and makes every rename touch two files. Across these 22 pairs no test-function name collides; 8 pairs carry helper/fixture/class definitions with differing bodies and every other colliding definition is identical. The pair list with per-pair rename sets, filtered from enumeration (2) of the test-suite epic's first comment, is itemised in this ticket's first comment. Paths under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` are stated at the current name; the reconciler epic (friended-brainsick-degus) rename carries them to their post-rename paths before this story starts. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
Directories: `tests/unit/metrics/`, `tests/unit/workflow/`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` — 22 pairs, 8 renames (`test_event_metrics`, `test_git_metrics`, `test_registry`, `test_sidecar_metrics`, `test_gate_error_sidecar`, `test_canonical_link_diff`, `test_canonical_outbound_equivalence`, `test_backend_scalar_surface`). For each pair: `cat` the held-out module into the base under a `# ── held-out oracles (merged from <name>_heldout.py) ──` divider; keep the base module docstring and append the held-out docstring's "what it proves" paragraph; dedupe identical definitions (`pytestmark` counts here — keep the base copy); rename differing definitions and repoint their callers; `git rm` the held-out file. Rename rule: suffix the HELD-OUT definition `_heldout` (e.g. `_load_heldout`) and repoint its callers; keep the base copy of identical definitions. The autouse fixture `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface{,_heldout}.py::_clean` has identical bodies: the merge keeps the base copy, so the base mechanism key survives and the held-out key buckets `stale`. No test body changes.

## Scope
In scope: the 22 base modules under `tests/unit/metrics/`, `tests/unit/workflow/` and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` named in the first comment and their 22 `_heldout` twins. Out of scope: the `tests/unit/` root pairs (S1), `tests/interfaces/` and `tests/integration/` (S3), `tests/scripts/` (S4), the 78 unpaired held-out renames (S5), `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`, every file under `src/`, and any test body change.

## Testing
Per pair: `pytest --collect-only -q <base> <heldout>` before and `pytest --collect-only -q <base>` after — counts equal (both recorded on this ticket); `pytest <base>` green. `make test` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero paired twins remain in these directories: for each of the 22 pairs `git ls-files <base>_heldout.py` prints nothing (the unpaired `_heldout` modules in these directories are untouched here and renamed in S5).
- [ ] Per-pair node counts reconcile: each merged base collects exactly the sum of the two prior counts, from the before/after `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0 with `new=0`; the held-out `_clean` autouse key of `test_backend_scalar_surface_heldout.py` buckets `stale`, which `--check` accepts (`scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py:51-57`), and `--update-stale` is not run.
- [ ] `make verify` green.
